title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: An upgrade rebuilds the index instead of trusting a stale one
summary: Three parser fixes shipped without moving the index version, so an upgrade restored the old reading of every file left untouched. On a project of 5088 files, 43 of them came back wrong.

highlights.title: The stored index no longer survives a parser fix
highlights.description: An upgrade rebuilds it once. The 43 affected files carried 45 wrong parent types, one class listed as its own parent, and 6 declarations missing from the Outline, from Go to Definition and from Find Usages.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Upgrading rebuilds the index instead of restoring a reading the current parser no longer agrees with.
A recorded reference pins what the parser writes to disk, so the next parser change cannot ship without the index version that discards the stale copies.
